title: 30% + $10 Bonus Cashback on Vodafone $50 150GB 28 Days Prepaid Plus Starter Pack for $17 (Activation Required) @ ShopBack App
body:
Deal: 30% + $10 Bonus Cashback on Vodafone $50 150GB 28 Days Prepaid Plus Starter Pack for $17 (Activation Required) @ ShopBack App

[BlackorRed] great deal, got tracked of $5.09 for $17 plus $10 bonus CB via quest so $1.91 out-of-pocket
[Iluvfreebies] Did the Bonus also tracked and marked as competed on the app?
[BlackorRed] nah, $28.45 to go so don't think $10 will be credited, anyway, still good deal if you just need temporary sim for a month
[jimojr] You need to spend $45.45 or more to qualify for the $10 bonus, not just $17.
[Aa44] My $10 bonus cashback is showing $28.45 to go 😅
[hcycheung15] I pressed the redeem $10 after and not before purchasing. Any chance that will affect my chances of getting it?

Or is the $17 price just the base spend, meaning I still need to add $28.45 worth of other items spending to reach the $45.45 total threshold required to unlock the $10 bonus?
[HopSkipJumpFallSplat] @gotyourback
Will the quest be honoured?
[tman2020] SIM card only as per conditions. Can't see cashback applicable for esim.
[Stoptheban] Who is upvoting this post? Purchased but $10 bonus cashback is showing $28.45 to go like many mentioned above.
[ElectricMallet] I’m expecting them to award the bonus. Met all the T&Cs by purchasing the $50 prepaid plus sim.
[jimojr] You can buy two more. That way, you'll get three $50 SIMs for under $26.
[ozbar] lol subscribing a phone plan is like chess games nowaday. F()king stupid complicated.
